title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 4 fix, round 2, is in. A masked select no longer records a `value` attribute, including one that was in the HTML. Option values stay starred and labels stay as written, and `selected` stays omitted. Stars of the same length on the select would have named the chosen option. Text inputs and textareas still keep stars. When `maskAllInputs` is false and the select is not in a masked region, the select value is recorded as typed. ADR 0018 supersedes only that point of ADR 0015.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Still open: part 5 (`takeFullSnapshot`). The issue definition of done is not met yet.
